# P36.1a — Host-level opt-out register + reservation-refused state + gate refusal

**Requirement ids:** **SIG-INGEST-046c** (§23.7 — an affirmative
machine-readable rights reservation is honoured as a refusal, recorded on the
rights record, stored distinctly from `UNDETERMINED`) and the **§26 rule 7**
opt-out obligation under **SIG-INGEST-036** (opt-outs honoured *immediately* —
the runtime register the E2-06/NEW-3 gap analysis found missing;
SIG-INGEST-036/037 build under ADR-168, unamended).
**Ticket:** `docs/tickets/265_P36.1a__opt-out-register-and-reservation-refusal.md`
(manifest row 265, Round 11 / P36, sub-round 11B) · **Base:**
`r11/P35.1a-scheduler-of-record-live-diff-cron-lint` · **Branch:**
`r11/P36.1a-opt-out-register-and-reservation-refusal` · **Production
mutations:** none — engineering only: no `ingestion_permitted` flip (HG-03 is
the operator's), no live fetch, no external contact of any kind · **Size:**
~1,380 changed lines — inside the L-split-a budget (≤3,000).

## Why

E2-06 found two MUSTs unbuilt: rule 7's *immediate* host-level opt-out
("immediately" cannot mean "after a rebuild and redeploy") and
SIG-INGEST-046c's affirmative reservation refusal (F2a: "no affirmative
rights-reservation state"). This row builds both under the recorded GATE-P
answers (A-5's GL-GATE-08 re-confirmation, B-6's UA/contact posture).

## What ships

- **`connectors/opt_out.py` + `data/opt_out_register.toml`** — the committed,
  append-only host-level opt-out register (`sig.opt-out-register/1`): bare
  hosts covering themselves and sub-domains, each row evidence-bearing
  (`host` + `recorded_on` + `evidence`), malformed rows fail closed.
  `PoliteFetcher` consults it **before every fetch — before the robots
  probe** — so a listed host receives zero egress. `$SIG_OPT_OUT_REGISTER`
  names an operator-supplied file consulted per run: an entry applies with
  **no registry rebuild and no redeploy** (the "immediately" seam).
- **`policy.crawler.detect_reservation`** — affirmative reservation
  detection on the response envelope: `Content-Signal` directives
  (`ai-train=no` and the sibling automated-use keys), `TDM-Reservation`
  (EU DSM Article 4, header + TDMRep meta forms), and `X-Robots-Tag`
  `noai`/`noimageai`. Signals are returned verbatim as evidence; absent or
  malformed signals are never refusals (and never grants).
- **`policy.rights.RightsReservation` + `RightsRecord.reservation`** — the
  *refused* state, additive and optional: `kind` (closed vocabulary:
  `content_signal`, `tdm_reservation`, `article_4`, `x_robots_tag`,
  `express_terms`, `opt_out`, `other`), the verbatim signal, `observed_on`,
  and an evidence pointer — asserted only on evidence (§3.1). `is_refused`
  is a separate axis from `is_undetermined`: unresolved rights invite the
  Stage-0 conversation, a reservation closes it.
- **Gate wiring** — `assert_loadable` refuses a source carrying a recorded
  reservation on every path (fixture, replay, live); `live_gate_reasons`
  names both the reservation and an opt-out-listed homepage host;
  `review.py`'s flip-metadata rule refuses a flip on a refused record and
  `GateBreakdown` exposes `rights_reserved` (never flip-ready, never
  loadable); `sig-connectors review-status` prints `reserved=`; `validate`
  fails on a malformed register.
- **`net.py`** — `HostOptOut` (raised before any egress, recorded on
  `opt_out_refusals`) and `ReservationRefused` (the response's bytes are
  never captured; verbatim signals recorded on `reservations`). A robots
  `Disallow` is **not** a reservation: GL-GATE-08 is byte-for-byte
  preserved — disallows still proceed and stamp `robots_disregarded`, now
  alongside (never instead of) an affirmative reservation.
- **`pipeline.py`** — both refusals land on `report.refusals` as
  first-class dispositions (never disappearances, never swallowed
  exceptions); the run continues to the next target and no claim derives
  from refused bytes.
- **`registry.py`** — an optional `[sources.<id>.rights.reservation]`
  sub-table parses the recorded refusal, fail-closed on a malformed row.
- **Tests** — `tests/connectors/test_opt_out.py` (29), extended
  `tests/unit/test_policy_crawler.py` (+11), new
  `tests/unit/test_policy_rights.py` (5): register parse/normalise/
  sub-domain/env-override/fail-closed, zero-egress refusal, Content-Signal /
  TDM / X-Robots-Tag / Article-4 meta fixtures, refused≠UNDETERMINED,
  robots-disallow≠reservation, gate refusals on every seam, run-report
  recording.

## Carries / boundaries

- S6R-28: every reservation encountered routes to the operator (the
  GATE-G5 packet); a reservation on an A-8 express-terms row routes per
  S6 R-19. No fixture reservation maps to a real host.
- Out of scope per the ticket: the crawler-conduct text half (P36.1b), any
  `ingestion_permitted` flip, Stage-0 outreach, publishing the register
  (Stream J), SIG-INGEST-037 amendment (already ADR-168).
- No DEFERRALS row closed — the robots/opt-out rows name hosts this register
  will serve; none of their verification words match this mechanism row.
